request: What impact did passing Obamacare have on the federal budget?
escalation_reason: The quick pass verified only 1 fact(s).

reply.reply: The ACA was projected to reduce federal deficits, but the available evidence here does not establish its realized overall net budget impact. The February 2011 CBO/JCT estimate projected a $210 billion deficit reduction over FY2012–FY2021 (CRS R45244, PDF p. 6); this was a forecast, not an observed result. More recent CRS data show more than $54 billion in premium tax credits claimed for tax year 2022, a single budget component rather than a full accounting (CRS R44425, PDF p. 12). See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261025-153249-890b.html) for details.
reply.reasoning: The evidence answers the projected budget impact and documents a later realized subsidy component, but does not calculate the ACA’s comprehensive realized net effect.
